failure.source: The stream will not open. Try another line.
failure.buffering: Buffering too long. Try another line or a lower quality.
failure.videoDecode: Video decoding failed. Try turning off hardware decoding in Settings.

autoLowered: Unstable network: switched to {quality}. You can switch back under Quality.
audioOnlyFailed: Could not switch to audio only; the picture is back
restoreVideoFailed: Could not restore the picture; still audio only
pipNeedsVideo: Picture-in-picture is available once the video shows
noApp: The app was not found; opening in the browser
noFrameToCapture: There is no picture to capture

sleep.hint: Pauses playback and background sound when the time is up
sleep.audioOnlySubtitle: For sleep: keep only the sound
sleep.invalidMinutes: Enter a number of minutes from 1 to {max}

lineFailedMany: This line failed. Retry or switch lines.
enableMonitoringFirst: Turn on scheduled live checks in Recording settings first
stoppingRecording: Stopping the recording; recorded files are kept
taskRemoved: Recording task removed; recorded files are kept
quickPanelHint: Long-press the video for the quick panel; long-press a danmaku to copy or block it
shareCodeCopied: Share code copied. Paste it in Pure Live to open the room.
streamUrlCopied: Stream URL copied. It expires; copy it again later.
noLiveFollows: None of your follows are live
volumePlayerOnly: Only the player's volume changes, not your phone's media volume

key.escape: Close a panel → leave full screen or theatre mode → leave the room

tip.desktop: Press C to show or hide chat, T for theatre mode and ? for all shortcuts
tip.touch: Pinch to change the aspect ratio; long-press the video for the quick panel

noRoomsToSwitch: No live rooms to switch to
swipeHint: You can turn on swiping between rooms in Settings › Playback

tv.hint: Up and down change rooms, left opens the room list, right the playback settings, OK shows the controls
